trigger.time: the time must be written as HH:mm, for example 02:00.
trigger.monthDay: the day must be from 1 to 31, 0 for the last day of the month, or -1 to -30 for days before the last day.
trigger.interval: the interval must be a whole number of hours from 1 to 24.
trigger.from: the start time must be written as HH:mm, for example 08:00.
trigger.to: the end time must be written as HH:mm, for example 20:00.
trigger.fromAfterTo: the start time must not be after the end time.

retention.keep: keep must be a number from 1 to {max}.
retention.weekday: the anchor must be a weekday, for example Sunday.
retention.monthDay: the anchor must be a day from 1 to 31, 0 for the last day of the month, or -1 to -30 for days before the last day.
retention.yearDate: the anchor must be a date written as MM-DD, for example 01-01.
retention.invalid: The retention rule is not valid: {problem}
